channel.title: Daily Science Intake
channel.description: We will include a daily research summary — from an AI creator — to listen to whenever, and use it as a way to increase our exposure to science! In a nutshell, lazy people's way of reading papers.
channel.itunes:author: Paz Nativ

item.title: Rethinking Wastewater: Can Short Sludge Ages Save the Planet?
item.description: Paz selected a provocative discussion paper from Technion researchers proposing a radical operational shift in wastewater treatment — running activated sludge at very short retention times, eliminating nitrification, recovering ammonia through ion exchange, and dramatically reducing greenhouse gas emissions while creating valuable fertilizer products instead of destroying nutrients.
